description: List every HonestHook API endpoint: public profiles (followers, following, posts count, bio, verified), recent posts, the historical trend archive, and per-profile history. Returns the URL and the query parameters for each, and says which ones you can call as a tool on this server — profiles through `fetch_profile`, posts through `fetch_posts` — and which are HTTP only. No API key needed, and it costs 0 credits.
name: list_endpoints
title: List API endpoints
